tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Find free 3D models by words, category and format. Returns each match with its page, licence, credit line and main download URLs.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: The full record of one model: every file with its URL, size and SHA-256, stats, previews and the credit line.

tools.name: get_attribution
tools.description: The credit line to add to a project that uses a model, as text, HTML or Markdown. The link must be kept.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The model categories and how many models each holds.
